edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in mintCryptoKaijus.
block.timestamp compared to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP controls startingIndexBlock assignment in mintCryptoKaijus.
tokenURI reveal branch is gated on block.timestamp >= REVEAL_TIMESTAMP, making metadata miner-timestamp dependent.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is read to decide revealed vs prereveal URI.
startingIndex is consumed to compute the offset token URI.
mintCryptoKaijus invokes _safeMint which calls onERC721Received on an attacker-controlled recipient.
presaleMintCryptoKaijus invokes _safeMint, triggering external receiver callback.
numberOfTokens parameter drives the mint loop in mintCryptoKaijus.
numberOfTokens parameter drives the mint loop in presaleMintCryptoKaijus.
_numberOfTokens parameter controls the reservation mint loop.
mintIndex local is passed as tokenId to _safeMint.
withdraw computes the balance and then executes ETH transfers to external wallets.
balance local is split and forwarded in the withdraw transfers.
setStartingIndex derives its result from blockhash-based entropy.
MAX_CRYPTO_KAIJUS_SUPPLY is the modulus for the derived starting index.
startingIndexBlock is read to fetch the blockhash entropy source.
setStartingIndex writes and normalizes startingIndex.
saleIsActive must be true or minting reverts.
presaleEnded must be true for public minting.
mintPrice is multiplied by quantity and checked against msg.value.
maxToMint caps the per-transaction quantity.
wallet1 is the destination of the 85% transfer.
wallet2 is the destination of the remaining transfer.
saleIsActive is required for presale minting.
mintPrice payment check applies to presale minting.
presaleSupply bounds the presale mint total.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens parameter only carries data into mintCryptoKaijus and should collapse into it.
numberOfTokens parameter is local to presaleMintCryptoKaijus and should merge into it.
_numberOfTokens parameter only feeds reserveCryptoKaijus and should merge into it.
mintIndex local is immediately consumed by the _safeMint unsafe operation.
balance local is used solely to split the ETH transfer in withdraw.
